fields.statement: QA at f255dc77 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath) in a fresh Rhiza root + project under a scratch HOME, fake rex on PATH. Real readings (no RHIZA_TEST_NOW): host /proc/loadavg 12.17 7.77 on 4 cores; with maxLoad 0.1 rhiza daemon --once started nothing, logged 'holding new runs: load-high: 1-minute load 3.04 per core, over the limit of 0.10', and skipped the accepted change set with reason load-high; a second poll kept the original since time with no new hold line. maxLoad 0 + minMemory 100G held with memory-low on the real MemAvailable (11.0 GiB). Injected readings with RHIZA_TEST_NOW + detach log: load1/load5 3.5/3.5 held; 1/3.5 stayed held ('5-minute load 3.50 ... not yet under'); 1/3.0 stayed held; 1/2.9 logged 'released the load-high hold' and started the run (detach log shows rhiza run start). maxLoad 0 and minMemory 0 disable. --max-load 0.01 on the command line held too; --max-load -2 exits 2.

QA at f255dc77 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath) in a fresh Rhiza root + project under a scratch HOME, fake rex on PATH. rhiza daemon settings lists rhiza.daemon.maxLoad = 3.0 and rhiza.daemon.minMemory = 2G (default, machine); daemon set maxLoad 2.5 and minMemory 4G write the root rhiza.toml [daemon]; maxLoad -1, maxLoad busy, minMemory lots and minMemory 4Q each exit 2 and cmp shows rhiza.toml unchanged; 0 accepted for each; rhiza daemon --help documents --max-load and --min-memory.

QA at f255dc77 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath) in a fresh Rhiza root + project under a scratch HOME, fake rex on PATH. rhiza daemon status text and --json after real polls show 'Load: 3.04 per core (1 minute), 1.94 (5 minutes)' matching /proc/loadavg divided by nproc, 'Memory available: 11.0 GiB' matching MemAvailable, and 'New runs held: load-high since <time>: <detail>' / hold {reason, since, detail}; after the release 'New runs held: no'. Daemon stderr had one hold line on the held poll, none on still-held polls, one release line on the releasing poll. With TEST_NOW and no injected readings health showed 'no readings on this platform'.

QA at f255dc77 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath) in a fresh Rhiza root + project under a scratch HOME, fake rex on PATH. After a real memory-low hold began at 20:13:30Z (minMemory 100G), rhiza health read with RHIZA_TEST_NOW 20:42 showed 'ok load'; at 20:44 'warn load new runs held for 30m0s (memory-low): 11.0 GiB available, under the minimum of 100.0 GiB' with next: rhiza daemon set rhiza.daemon.minMemory <value>. Under 30 minutes on the real clock it showed ok with the live readings and limits.

QA at f255dc77 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath) in a fresh Rhiza root + project under a scratch HOME, fake rex on PATH. Same real memory-low hold: rhiza inbox --json at 20:42 had no hold item, at 20:44 one item kind memory-low with the reading, limit and 'held for 30m0s'; after a later poll released a load-high hold, rhiza inbox 30+ minutes later listed no load or memory item. go test -trimpath ./internal/tui/inboxapp/... passes.
